_comment: The first farms, from the green lots in stock in October 2026. The farms page shows these until Farm documents are published in Sanity, and `npm run seed:sanity` copies them there. Empty fields are hidden on the page. Marlon Bolaños and Sebastián Ramírez details are from roaster listings of their lots (blackwhiteroasters.com, thewaytocoffee.com, eightouncecoffee.ca), October 2026.

farms.name: Marlon Bolaños
farms.story: Marlon Bolaños farms in Acevedo, southern Huila, with brothers Hemerson and Pedro as Three Coffee Farmers. The brothers run the crops and day-to-day farm work, and Marlon handles processing, cupping and sales after training as a barista and cupper at SENA. We hold three of their lots: a natural Geisha, a honey Pink Bourbon and a natural decaf, all SMS exclusives in the Coffee Lab.

farms.name: Finca El Placer
farms.story: Sebastián Ramírez runs Finca El Placer in Quindío, in Colombia's coffee axis, and is known for experimental co-ferments. For this lot, ripe Caturra cherries ferment with blackberries under CO2, then go through a thermal shock before drying. The result is intensely sweet and jammy.

farms.name: Strawberry Jam
farms.story: A Colombian co-ferment fermented with strawberry. It is our brightest, fruitiest lot and we roast it light to keep it that way.

farms.name: Salmo
farms.story: A natural-process Brazil that gives our blends their body and a nutty, chocolate base.

farms.name: Guji
farms.story: A washed coffee from the Guji highlands of southern Ethiopia: floral and tea-like, with citrus up front.

farms.name: Veracruz
farms.story: A natural-process coffee from Veracruz, on Mexico's Gulf coast. Easygoing and sweet, it works in almost any blend.
